title: Oil rises as US-Iran strikes escalate
gist: A short Al-Monitor podcast episode summary notes oil prices rose as US-Iran strikes escalated, Germany tested an Israeli ballistic missile system, and Egypt is pursuing stronger military ties with China during President Xi Jinping's visit.

insights.claim: Germany tested an Israeli-made ballistic missile defense system, indicating continued European interest in Israeli defense technology even amid the broader Gaza/Lebanon conflict backdrop.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Continued European procurement interest in Israeli missile-defense systems is a data point for Israeli defense-export demand despite regional conflict headlines.
insights.quote: Germany tested an Israeli ballistic missile system and Egypt is eyeing stronger military ties with China during President Xi Jinping’s visit.

insights.claim: Egypt is exploring stronger military ties with China, a shift signaled during a visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: A traditionally US-aligned military partner like Egypt courting Chinese defense ties would signal shifting Middle East alignment away from exclusive U.S. dependence — worth tracking for longer-term regional arms-market share.
insights.quote: Egypt is eyeing stronger military ties with China during President Xi Jinping’s visit.
